tools.name: list_factors
tools.description: List factor ids, the daily closes each needs, the demo tickers and the methodology version. Free.

tools.name: mint_api_key
tools.description: Create a free API key (100 scoring calls a day, 5 positions). Free; limited to 5 keys per IP per day. The key is shown once. Put it in your MCP client config as the x-api-key header, or pass it as the api_key argument of the scoring tools for the rest of this session.

tools.name: score_demo_portfolio
tools.description: Score the five labeled SYNTH.* demo tickers. Synthetic series, not market data. Works without a key. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: score_portfolio
tools.description: Compute named factor exposures and risk contribution for positions. You must supply daily close history (volume for liquidity, market_cap for size, benchmark for beta). findings.detail: Description of "mint_api_key" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
